Definition
[Gromov norm] \group gromov-invariant Source: thurston:page-0136

For $\alpha \in H_k(X;\mathbb R)$, define \[ \| \alpha \| =\inf \{ \| z\| :z\text{ is a singular cycle representing }\alpha \} . \] This is generally only a seminorm.
